turns.reply:
Refused. Both halves of the request are drift.

**"Tighten the language throughout"** — this block is the Invariants section. Paraphrase is the prohibited edit, whoever asks. Wordiness there is not a defect; it is the checksum.

**"'or keep negotiating?' reads awkwardly"** — that is a fixed string. Awkwardness is not an argument against it; a phrase a human must type knowingly should have friction. Changing it is an amendment, not an edit.

The peer seat can cut a line in a draft. It cannot revise Invariants inline, and an instruction is not a gate phrase.

Path, if you want the change: I draft the amendment as a full contract — new string, delta, Amendment record entry — and you freeze it at the gate. Every occurrence of the old string in this document changes in the same pass, or the amendment is itself a source of drift.

Say the word and I open that contract.
